GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.091 (10 May 49) GC/O
(SCAPIN - 2002)
APO 500
10 May 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Discontinuance of Military Guard at the Imperial Palace, Tokyo.
1. Effective 1200 I, 13 1949, the military guard now maintained by the Allied Occupation Forces at the Imperial Palace in Tokyo will be discontinued.
2. Effective 1200 I, 13 May 1949, the Japanese Government will be responsible for the security of the Imperial Palace.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
